```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/devcontainers/php:1-8.3
      options: --user vscode
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PHP extensions
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libzip-dev \
            libxml2-dev \
            libcurl4-openssl-dev \
            libonig-dev \
            libsqlite3-dev \
            zip \
            unzip

      - name: Install Composer dependencies
        run: composer install -n --prefer-dist

      - name: Run tests
        run: composer test-quick-fail

  codeql:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      security-events: write
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        language: ['php']
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Initialize CodeQL
        uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3
        with:
          languages: ${{ matrix.language }}

      - name: Autobuild
        uses: github/codeql-action/autobuild@v3

      - name: Perform CodeQL Analysis
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3
```

yaml:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/devcontainers/php:1-8.3
      options: --user vscode
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PHP extensions
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libzip-dev \
            libxml2-dev \
            libcurl4-openssl-dev \
            libonig-dev \
            libsqlite3-dev \
            zip \
            unzip

      - name: Install Composer dependencies
        run: composer install -n --prefer-dist

      - name: Run tests
        run: composer test-quick-fail

  codeql:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      security-events: write
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        language: ['php']
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Initialize CodeQL
        uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3
        with:
          languages: ${{ matrix.language }}

      - name: Autobuild
        uses: github/codeql-action/autobuild@v3

      - name: Perform CodeQL Analysis
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3
